scope: Independent runtime ARM64 blocks and single-CPU LKL/Bionic/ART/Android desktop on macOS; product NCE unchanged; iPhone and signed APK install/update unverified.
measurement: Each embedded report records its sources, binaries, platform and configuration. Memory statistics include arithmetic sample mean, sampled peak and latest; lifetime RSS peak is separate. Desktop duration covers the complete automated scenario, including waits, applications and shutdown.

independent.scope: Independent runtime ARM64 blocks; no Linux/Android/iPhone integration
independent.measurement: Three warm rounds per engine in separate processes, reversed process order for GCD. Same ARM64 bytes and checked results. Direct includes one-million-instruction slice entries; Unicorn includes register exchange. Memory phases include initialization and result verification, with arithmetic sample mean, sampled peak and latest; lifetime RSS peak is separate.

independent_memory_off.scope: Independent Direct boundaries and calculation with memory sampling disabled

linux_instructions.scope: Native single-CPU LKL with translated ARM64 userspace; selected workload only; iPhone unverified
linux_instructions.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and selected Linux mapping implementation included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.
